body:
### Description

Hello,

I've observed this weird bug for a while.

I join a room and after a while I can no longer send messages.

Log says this:

```
2022-12-17 19:25:07,773 - synapse.access.http.8008 - 415 - DEBUG - OPTIONS-650 - [long IPv6]- 8008 - Received request: OPTIONS /_matrix/client/r0/sync?filter=10&timeout=30000&since=s1985937_10724101_0_338903_77820_147_29332_808319_0
```

Then I leave a room and create a new conversation and things work for a while.

415 means Unsupported Media Type. I cannot see a reason why suddenly regular text would be unsupported.

(Now, this happens both with SchildiChat and Element, so not a bug limited to SchildiChat.)

### Steps to reproduce

- join room
- use it for a while
- messages can no longer be sent

### Homeserver

erebion.eu

### Synapse Version

1.73.0

### Installation Method

Debian packages from packages.matrix.org

### Database

 PostgreSQL 13.9 (Debian 13.9-0+deb11u1) on x86_64-pc-linux-gnu, compiled by gcc (Debian 10.2.1-6) 10.2.1 20210110, 64-bit, not ported, not restored a backup

### Workers

Single process

### Platform

Debian Stable (Bullseye / 11), VM

### Configuration

None

### Relevant log output

```shell
2022-12-17 19:25:05,365 - synapse.access.http.8008 - 415 - DEBUG - OPTIONS-645 - [long IPv6] - 8008 - Received request: OPTIONS /_matrix/client/r0/sync?filter=10&timeout=30000&since=s1985937_10724100_0_338903_77820_147_29332_808319_0
2022-12-17 19:25:05,365 - synapse.access.http.8008 - 460 - DEBUG - OPTIONS-645 - [long IPv6] - 8008 - {None} Processed request: 0.000sec/-0.000sec (0.000sec, 0.000sec) (0.000sec/0.000sec/0) 0B 204 "OPTIONS /_matrix/client/r0/sync?filter=10&timeout=30000&since=s1985937_10724100_0_338903_77820_147_29332_808319_0 HTTP/1.1" "Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) SchildiChat/1.11.13-sc.1 Chrome/104.0.5112.124 Electron/20.3.0 Safari/537.36" [0 dbevts]
```


### Anything else that would be useful to know?

So far all rooms have been created by mautrix-signal, but it does not have any errors in the log which makes me think that it is probably a bug in Synapse.
